address: Koningin Astrid Boulevard 5, Noordwijk aan Zee, 2202 BK, Netherlands
bio: Welcome to the Dutch Riviera, where dining with your toes in the sand is sure to give you that holiday feeling. The relaxed terrace affords a wonderful view of the sea, or you can enjoy the trendy brasserie ambience inside. This is the place to come for a plate of ultra-fresh oysters and seafood, followed by classically prepared dishes in which the produce (mainly fish, of course) steals the show. Simple and delicious!...
